quote.citation: 1962, “Monster Mash”, Bobby "Boris" Pickett and Lenny Capizzi (lyrics), performed by Bobby (Boris) Pickett and The Crypt-Kickers:
quote.text: I was working in the lab late one nightWhen my eyes beheld an eerie sightFor my monster, from his slab, began to riseAnd suddenly, to my surpriseHe did the MashHe did the Monster Mash.
A man dressed as a lab tech, his blue scrubs startlingly pale against the vivid red and black chaos, moved into sight from behind the SUV. He carried an assault rifle.

quote.citation: 2023 August 2, Ben Tinker, Meg Tirrell and Brenda Goodman, “New director named at National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases after Fauci’s retirement”, in CNN‎[1]:
quote.text: The NIAID supports projects at universities and research organizations around the United States as well as a network of 21 NIAID labs across the country.
